notes: Anglo-Eastern Plantations (AIM/Main Market UK, USD reporting). Operates ~120,000 ha (296.5k acres) of oil palm in Sumatra and Sabah/Bintulu. UK semi-annual reporter (H1 interim June + FY December). Revenue is CPO + palm kernel sales; segment split by Indonesia / Malaysia operations from annual report segment notes. AEP carries minimal debt; large net cash position from accumulated CPO cash flows. Hectares converted to thousand acres via × 2.47. Per-share dividend declared in pence-sterling at AGM (board uses GBp); reported here as USD per disclosure year. Coverage 2020-2024 from published annual reports; 2025 H1 from interim release.

periods.notes: H1 2020: revenue $110.5M, EBITDA recovering on CPO price rebound off COVID lows
FY20: CPO avg ~$640/t. Net cash position reflects deleveraging; no segmental EBITDA disclosed to subdivide here.
H1 2021: CPO surge to ~$1,000/t lifts revenue ~+39% YoY
FY21: record CPO pricing, revenue +58% YoY, EBITDA margin ~33%
H1 2022: peak CPO pricing post Russia/Indonesia export curbs
FY22: record year. Cash >$180M; no material gross debt
FY23: revenue softens with CPO normalization
FY24: latest from seed. Revenue $372M, EBITDA $99M, net cash $181M, NAV/share $14.18, biological asset/property book $271M
H1 2025: estimated from interim trading update; subject to verification
